title: narcissus hedraeanthus subsp. luteolentus
intro: Narcissus hedraeanthus subsp. luteolentus, commonly known as a plant species within the Amaryllidaceae family, is a type of bulbous perennial that belongs to the Narcissus genus. This plant has been traditionally used for its medicinal properties, providing various health benefits such as anti-inflammatory and antimicrobial effects, which can aid in treating wounds and infections. The therapeutic actions of Narcissus hedraeanthus subsp. luteolentus include its sedative, antispasmodic, and expectorant properties, making it useful in treating anxiety, muscle spasms, and respiratory issues. The bioactive constituents of this plant include alkaloids, which have been identified as the primary compounds responsible for its medicinal properties, including galanthamine and homoharringtonine.
